# E-Collab Project Loop

Use this lifecycle for non-trivial tasks:

Discover -> Understand -> Plan -> Select agents/skills -> Implement -> Test -> Review -> Integrate -> Verify -> Document.

At each loop, maintain explicit acceptance criteria. If validation fails, return to evidence gathering and root-cause analysis rather than patching symptoms. Stop only when the acceptance criteria pass or a concrete blocker is documented.

Small obvious changes may use a shortened loop, but still require relevant validation.
